info.title: HTML&HTML Website AI & Search Readiness API
info.description: Public contracts for the 12-engine evidence diagnosis, 13 non-scoring Intelligence Audits, seven readiness lenses, 12 non-scoring Enterprise Opportunity signals, paid AI Mention Tracker, the entitlement-gated $99 AI Search Visibility Roadmap, and its automated ZIP delivery pack. Evaluated signals are internal heuristics; NOT_MEASURED and REQUIRES_CONTEXT are preserved instead of fabricated scores.

200.description: Health state including 12 scan engines, 13 intelligence analyses, seven readiness lenses and 12 opportunity signals

post.summary: Run public evidence diagnosis + Intelligence + Enterprise Opportunity
post.description: Returns canonical 12-engine scores unchanged, all public findings, 13 Intelligence Audits, seven readiness lenses and 12 Enterprise Opportunity signals. The opportunity layer diagnoses evidence-backed commercial/search/AI readiness gaps but does not include exact implementation actions.

200.description: Complete evidence-backed diagnostic result with unchanged 12-engine core scores and non-scoring intelligence/opportunity layers. Exact implementation instructions are not included.

post.summary: Run Search & AI Intelligence plus Enterprise Opportunity Audit
post.description: Returns exactly 13 Intelligence analyses, seven readiness lenses and 12 non-scoring Enterprise Opportunity signals. Information Gain and commercial relevance are internal prioritization heuristics, not Google scores or traffic/revenue forecasts. Render parity, observed visibility and source-code governance remain NOT_MEASURED/REQUIRES_CONTEXT without required evidence.

post.summary: Generate the $99 entitlement-gated AI Search Visibility Roadmap v1.2
post.description: Internal commercial contract name remains FULL_SITE_FIX_MANDATE for backward compatibility. The customer-facing deliverable is the AI Search Visibility Roadmap. It adds owner, dependency, blast radius, implementation order, acceptance/regression tests, rollback and stop conditions for Enterprise Opportunity actions.

200.description: Paid Roadmap, 50-page maximum, including P0–P3 issue contracts, 13 Intelligence action contracts and 12 Enterprise Opportunity execution contracts

503.description: Paid implementation entitlement is not configured

post.summary: Generate and download the paid Roadmap ZIP package
post.description: Runs the same domain through the canonical scan and $99 Roadmap v1.2 contract. Returns a deterministic ZIP with 11 core files plus up to 30 evidence-bound page-level machine-surface manifests. Guest delivery requires a short-lived entitlement bound to both target domain and order_id. Only one proposed root llms.txt is generated; page-level files are Markdown machine-surface manifests and never fabricated page content.

parameters.name: x-htmlhtml-entitlement
parameters.description: Required for guest delivery; HMAC-signed, short-lived, domain+order-bound entitlement.
